title: Door, charging-machine and ignition interlocks on a gas-fired solution-treatment furnace
summary: Rapid discharge capability does not establish combustion permission in every movement state. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s gas-fired solution-furnace proposal for long bars, dated 6 March 2025, specifies door, travelling-frame and fork conditions alongside combustion-air, gas-pressure and flame monitoring. Map mechanical positions to combustion permissions before verifying loaded discharge and immersion.
